title: Engineering Trivia
tagline: Slider-based estimation trivia — 40 numbers every engineer should carry
hub_blurb: Estimate forty engineering quantities on linear and logarithmic scales, then see how well your numerical intuition is calibrated.
card_blurb: Game-show estimation trivia: drag a slider to guess 40 numbers every engineer should carry — yield strengths, ampacities, psi per foot — scored by how close your gut gets, with log-scale sliders for the order-of-magnitude questions. Solo or pass-and-play teams.
description: **Engineering Trivia (Should Have Known That)** — slider-based estimation trivia game for engineering students. 40 verified questions, 8 each across Statics & Mechanics, Materials, Electrical, Fluids & Thermo, and Everyday Engineering; linear sliders scored by percent error, logarithmic sliders (resistivity, speed of light, lethal current...) scored by order-of-magnitude error, with Bullseye/Close/Warm/Cold/Way Off bands. Animated guess-vs-truth reveal with a one-line "you should have known that because..." anchor for every number. Solo or 2–4 team pass-and-play with editable names and a running scoreboard; end screen calls out the sharpest and most should-have-known guesses. Single self-contained file, phone-first, works offline; the question bank is a commented array at the top of the file for instructors to edit.
